description: Personal credit institution cash-flow skeleton adapted from Banks and the supplied OneMain reference presentation. All 163 supplied unique concepts are retained once. Hierarchy does not prescribe arithmetic, equivalence, signs or complete coverage for an individual issuer.
classification_notes: The supplied 163-concept universe defines coverage; no frequency cutoff or issuer-specific completeness is inferred.
The reference guides presentation families only. Zeros, dashes, funds from operations and free cash flow do not establish source facts, taxonomy equivalence or reported calculations.
Operating, investing and financing totals have presentation children, not automatic summation relationships. Net flows, gross flows and overlapping totals must be resolved before calculation.
Loan investment purchases, collections and disposals remain separate from held-for-sale operating loan flows. Customer deposit funding differs from deposits held as assets.
Debt maturity, collateral, seniority, credit-line and securitization views overlap. Receivable securitizations classified as borrowings are not investment sale proceeds.
Instant cash balances, restricted investments, noncash transactions and cost disclosures remain separate from cash receipts and payments. Cash and exchange-rate effects must use matching scopes.
Preserve source signs. No universal reversal applies to IncreaseDecreaseIn or gain/loss concepts. Proposed classifications remain subject to issuer presentation review.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified against official taxonomy periodType for every supplied concept. Instant balances are not duration cash movements.
metadata_contract.unit_type: All supplied concepts use taxonomy monetary item types; source currencies and scales remain filing-specific.
metadata_contract.contra: False for cash-flow concepts; source signs and cash-flow presentation must be reconciled independently.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against local official 2026 schema and documentation copies. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy and units.

sources.description: 163 user-supplied unique us-gaap concepts for SIC 6141.

nodes.label: Operating activities
nodes.classification_note: Operating cash flow and indirect-method reconciliation. Children explain presentation families and do not prescribe arithmetic or source-fact signs.

children.label: Cash flow from operating activities
children.classification_note: Reported operating cash flow is the primary total. Indirect adjustments, gross held-for-sale flows and payment details can overlap; this hierarchy does not prescribe their sum.

children.label: Income starting point alternatives
children.classification_note: Reporting-entity net income and consolidated profit differ in noncontrolling-interest attribution. Select the starting point matching the issuer’s operating cash reconciliation.

children.label: Net income (loss) attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss
concepts.review_reason: Reporting-entity net income can exclude noncontrolling-interest income included in consolidated operating cash flow; reconcile the starting income scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfitLoss
concepts.review_reason: Consolidated profit includes noncontrolling interests and is not equivalent to the supplied reporting-entity NetIncomeLoss starting amount.

children.label: Noncash and other earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Noncash and nonoperating earnings adjustments can overlap reported aggregate reconciliation adjustments; reverse or retain signs only using issuer presentation.

children.label: Depreciation, amortization and accretion
children.classification_note: Aggregate and component depreciation, amortization and accretion disclosures overlap. No parent-to-child sum or universal reversal sign is prescribed.

children.label: Reported depreciation and amortization aggregates
children.classification_note: These are overlapping aggregates with different depletion/accretion coverage. Select the applicable reported adjustment; do not add alternative totals.

children.label: Asset depreciation and amortization
children.classification_note: Depreciation, intangible amortization and direct production/service depreciation-amortization may be included in reported aggregate adjustments; reconcile coverage before combining.

children.label: Depreciation and amortization in cost of goods and services

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSoldDepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Production and direct-service depreciation/amortization may already be included in a reported combined adjustment; establish the reconciliation scope.

children.label: Investment and loan yield amortization
children.classification_note: Investment discount/premium accretion and amortization differ from deferred loan origination fee amortization. Their signs depend on the earnings-to-cash reconciliation.

children.label: Accretion amortization of discounts and premiums investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:AccretionAmortizationOfDiscountsAndPremiumsInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment discount accretion and premium amortization can have opposite effects on interest income; use the reported net adjustment direction.

children.label: Amortization of deferred loan origination fees net

concepts.name: us-gaap:AmortizationOfDeferredLoanOriginationFeesNet
concepts.review_reason: Deferred loan origination fee amortization affects loan yield and can overlap other loan discount accretion; identify the loan-fee reconciliation component.

children.label: Financing cost and debt discount amortization
children.classification_note: The combined financing-cost-and-discount amount can include both separately supplied financing-cost amortization and debt discount/premium amortization.

children.label: Amortization of financing costs and discounts
Credit and other loss provisions
children.classification_note: Broad loan/lease/other provisions can include narrower loan or other-credit provisions. Reserve charges, reversals and noncredit provisions differ; do not add alternative exposure scopes.

children.label: Provision for loan lease and other losses
Financing receivable credit loss expense (reversal), excluding accrued interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts
concepts.review_reason: Doubtful-account provision may cover receivables outside the lending portfolio; determine exposure scope before combining with loan-loss provisions.

children.label: Share-based compensation adjustments
children.classification_note: Share-based compensation expense may include noncash awards and differ from capitalized award costs disclosed separately. Cash share withholding and exercise proceeds are separate transactions.

children.label: Deferred tax and share compensation tax adjustments
children.classification_note: Deferred tax expense, deferred tax balance changes and deferred-tax-and-credit adjustments overlap but use different measurement bases. Do not add these alternatives.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Deferred tax expense is an earnings component; isolate the amount included in the selected income starting point before reversing its noncash effect.

children.label: Increase decrease in deferred income taxes

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes
concepts.review_reason: A change in deferred tax balances can include OCI, acquisitions or other non-earnings movements; do not equate the full balance change with deferred tax expense.

children.label: Deferred income taxes and tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxesAndTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: This combined deferred-tax-and-tax-credit adjustment has broader scope than deferred tax expense alone; identify credits already included elsewhere.

children.label: Investment earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Only gains/losses included in the selected income starting point can be reversed. Reported sale proceeds belong in their cash-flow activity, separately from earnings adjustments.

children.label: General investment earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Gross gains, gross losses, net results, realized-only and unrealized measures are alternative views. Establish recognition in earnings before applying an operating reversal.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers investment results with unspecified asset and measurement scope.

children.label: Loan sale earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: All-loan and loan/lease results can include mortgage, note and consumer subsets. These earnings measures overlap and differ from sale cash proceeds.

children.label: Gain loss on sales of loans net

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers net loan-sale results that can contain multiple loan-class results.

children.label: Gain loss on sale of notes receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfNotesReceivable
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers notes-receivable disposal results rather than all lending disposals.

children.label: Asset and business disposal earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: PP&E disposal earnings and equity-method investment disposal earnings differ in asset scope and are separate from disposal cash receipts.

children.label: Gain (loss) on PP&E disposal, excluding oil/gas and timber

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers PP&E disposal results excluding oil/gas and timber property under its taxonomy definition.

children.label: Equity method investment realized gain loss on disposal

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentRealizedGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers equity-method investment disposal results rather than recurring affiliate earnings.

children.label: Derivative, hedge and debt extinguishment adjustments
children.classification_note: Derivative and hedged-item valuation changes can offset one another or affect OCI. Debt extinguishment adjustments can contain noncash issuance-cost write-offs; do not equate these results with settlement cash.

children.label: Gains losses on extinguishment of debt

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers debt extinguishment results that can include noncash unamortized financing costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: This measure covers unrealized derivative valuation changes that may be reported in earnings or OCI.

children.label: Gain Loss On Repurchase Of Debt Instrument

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnRepurchaseOfDebtInstrument
concepts.review_reason: Issuer debt repurchase earnings may overlap extinguishment earnings; isolate the noncash earnings adjustment from cash prepayment costs.

children.label: Net gain (loss) on derivatives not designated as hedges

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: Includes realized and unrealized derivative earnings; isolate noncash reconciliation adjustments from cash settlements and avoid overlap with unrealized derivative gains.

children.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain Loss Unrealized

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealized
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized transaction earnings are distinct from the exchange-rate effect on reconciled cash balances; check operating adjustment signs.

children.label: Other noncash earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Residual noncash adjustments must exclude the specific items already selected elsewhere in the income-to-cash reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNoncashIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other noncash income/expense is a residual adjustment that may already include specific impairment, valuation or compensation amounts; identify exclusions.

children.label: Mortgage-backed security earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: Security sale earnings differ from whole-loan sale earnings and sale cash proceeds; reconcile recognition and cash flow adjustment signs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
concepts.review_reason: MBS sale earnings need an earnings-to-cash reconciliation and may overlap investment gains; they are not loan sale proceeds.

children.label: Impairment adjustments
children.classification_note: Tangible asset and operating lease ROU impairment charges are earnings adjustments, not cash purchases; establish any overlap with combined impairment totals.

children.label: Changes in operating assets and liabilities
children.classification_note: This follows the reference presentation family without inventing a mapped net-change subtotal. Broad net changes and detailed account movements may overlap.

children.label: Operating asset changes
children.classification_note: Aggregate operating asset changes overlap specific receivable and residual asset changes; lending investment flows and held-for-sale operating flows remain distinct.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating assets
Increase decrease in accrued interest receivable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceivableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net accrued-interest receivable changes can already be included in aggregate operating asset changes; identify portfolio coverage before combining with other receivables.

children.label: Increase decrease in income taxes receivable
Increase decrease in loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Loans-held-for-sale movements can overlap origination and sale cash flows; identify whether the movement is the complete operating reconciliation adjustment.

children.label: Operating liability changes
children.classification_note: Accounts payable, combined accrued liabilities and residual liabilities overlap. Deferred revenue can include contract liabilities; do not add alternative scopes.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating liabilities
Increase decrease in interest payable net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest payable changes may already be included in accrued-liability movements; isolate the interest component before using this detail.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued liabilities and other operating liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This combined accrued-and-other-operating-liability movement can include both separately supplied categories; it is an overlapping aggregate.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities combines categories that may already be included in operating-liability changes; identify the accounts-payable increment.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued income taxes payable
Increase decrease in operating lease liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease liability changes can include new leases and modifications; do not treat the full movement as cash rent or combine it unadjusted with ROU amortization.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Contract With Customer Liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInUnearnedPremiums
concepts.review_reason: Excludes premiums amortized into income; reconcile the insurance liability rollforward before treating this change as a complete operating cash adjustment.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan cash flows
children.classification_note: Held-for-sale loan operating flows can already be reflected in held-for-sale balance-change adjustments. Do not combine a full balance adjustment and gross cash-flow presentation without reconciliation.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan origination and purchase payments
children.classification_note: Combined origination/purchase payments can include mortgage originations and all loan purchases; these are alternative breakdowns.

children.label: Payments for origination and purchases of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-sale origination and purchase payments may overlap the cash effect captured by the separately mapped held-for-sale balance change; reconcile gross flows and the indirect adjustment.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan sale and collection receipts
children.classification_note: Total loan sales can include mortgage and other-loan subsets. Sale-and-collection receipts have broader transaction coverage than sale-only measures.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Sale-only held-for-sale receipts overlap combined sale-and-collection receipts but exclude their collection component; select consistent portfolio and transaction scope.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and collection of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeldforsale
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-sale sale-and-collection proceeds include a collection component absent from sale-only measures; establish whether both views cover the same loans.

children.label: Other operating cash flows
children.classification_note: Operating lease cash payments and residual operating cash flows may already be reflected in the indirect reconciliation. Avoid deducting them again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease payments are cash outflows that may already be reflected through lease-related operating adjustments; do not deduct them a second time.

children.label: Other operating activities cash flow statement

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatement
concepts.review_reason: Other operating activities is a residual cash-flow line, not an extra total above the specific operating cash flows and adjustments.

children.label: Operating capital change alternatives
children.classification_note: Reported operating capital change is an aggregate alternative, not an additional component of the detailed operating asset and liability changes.

children.label: Operating cash-flow and reconciliation aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: The reported reconciliation adjustment total is not funds from operations or operating cash flow before working-capital changes unless issuer evidence establishes that scope.

children.label: Adjustments reconciling net income to operating cash flow

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdjustmentsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
concepts.review_reason: This reconciliation-adjustment aggregate can include both noncash items and operating asset/liability movements; it is not the reference presentation subtotal before asset/liability changes.

nodes.label: Cash flow from investing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported investing cash flow is the total. The reference presentation guides the capital expenditure, investment, lending and business transaction families; overlapping net/gross measures are not a calculation tree.

children.label: Capital expenditures
children.classification_note: PP&E purchases can be included in productive-asset purchases. Intangible purchases have a separate asset scope; no net capital-expenditure subtotal is invented.

children.label: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset purchases may cover PP&E and other productive assets; reconcile the acquisition scope with separately reported capital expenditures.

children.label: Investment purchases, sales and maturities
children.classification_note: Investment flows are separated by portfolio and transaction basis. Broad totals, net measures and gross receipt components overlap and must not be summed by hierarchy.

children.label: AFS debt security cash flows
children.classification_note: Combined sales/maturities can contain separate sales and maturity/prepayment/call receipts. Do not add the combined amount to its detail or net purchases without a reconciliation.

children.label: Payments to acquire available-for-sale securities debt
Proceeds from sale of available-for-sale securities debt
Proceeds from maturities prepayments and calls of available-for-sale securities
Proceeds from sale and maturity of available-for-sale securities
HTM debt security cash flows
children.classification_note: Combined HTM sale/maturity receipts overlap individual receipt categories. HTM sales remain distinct from maturity/prepayment/call receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and maturity of held-to-maturity securities
Other investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Other investment purchases and sale/maturity proceeds have residual asset coverage; combined sale/maturity receipts overlap sale-only receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other investments
Proceeds from sale and maturity of other investments
Broad investment cash-flow alternatives
children.classification_note: Marketable security purchases may overlap AFS, HTM and other investment purchases. Select the issuer’s portfolio scope rather than adding broad and narrow measures.

children.label: Loan and lease investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Investing loans are distinguished from loans originated or purchased for resale. Select either reconciled net flows or appropriate gross detail; do not add both.

children.label: Net loan and lease cash flows
children.classification_note: Net lending measures differ from gross loan purchase/sale flows. The origination-and-collection concept is defined as an inflow and needs transaction-specific context; no uniform sign is imposed.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from loans and leases
Payments for proceeds from loans receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Net loan-receivable payments/proceeds can include origination and collection flows covered by other loan measures; identify the lending portfolio and netting basis.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from other loans and leases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoansAndLeases
concepts.review_reason: Other-loan-and-lease net flows exclude classes presented elsewhere; establish the residual definition relative to the broader loan-and-lease measure.

children.label: Loan and lease origination and principal collection inflows

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollections1
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this as cash inflow related to originations and principal collections; identify the reported transaction and direction rather than assuming originations are outflows.

children.label: Loan and lease purchases
children.classification_note: Loan receivable and finance receivable acquisitions can cover overlapping contracts. Distinguish purchases from originations and principal collections.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Loan-receivable purchases can overlap finance-receivable acquisitions and net lending flows; establish contract coverage before choosing the gross purchase amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable acquisitions can overlap loan-receivable purchases but may cover different contracts; identify the financing assets acquired.

children.label: Loan and lease sales
children.classification_note: Finance receivable sale proceeds are investment disposals; distinguish them from principal collections and held-for-sale operating receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of finance receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable sale proceeds can overlap broader loan sale proceeds; establish the contract classes and holding intent.

children.label: Loan and finance receivable collections
children.classification_note: Collections can overlap across loan, finance-receivable and held-for-investment scopes. Principal collections exclude interest; do not add alternative scopes.

children.label: Proceeds From Collection Of Finance Receivables
Proceeds From Collection Of Loans Receivable
Proceeds From Principal Repayments On Loans And Leases Held For Investment
Business acquisitions and disposals
children.classification_note: Cash consideration is separated from purchase-price allocation and noncash equity consideration, which are in supplementary disclosures.

children.label: Business acquisition cash payments and acquired cash
children.classification_note: Gross acquisition payments and payments net of acquired cash are alternative measurements; reconcile acquired cash before selecting one.

children.label: Payments to acquire businesses net of cash acquired

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition payments are already net of acquired cash; do not subtract acquired cash again or add gross payments to this amount.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross acquisition cash payments exclude cash acquired; reconcile them to the net acquisition payment rather than adding gross and net measures.

children.label: Property and other asset disposal cash flows
children.classification_note: Asset sale receipts are distinct from earnings gains/losses reversed in operating activities. The property and asset classifications may overlap.

children.label: Productive asset sales and net flows
children.classification_note: Other PP&E disposal receipts are a subset of broader PP&E disposal proceeds; do not add total and detail.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
Proceeds From Sale Of Other Property Plant And Equipment
Other investing cash flows
children.classification_note: Residual investing flows exclude investment purchases, disposals, lending and acquisition flows already selected elsewhere.

children.label: Residual investing cash flows
children.classification_note: Other investing payments/proceeds are a residual net flow and must exclude separately selected investment, lending or acquisition flows.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from other investing activities
Other lending and interest earning asset cash flows
children.classification_note: Related-party advances and residual interest-earning asset flows may overlap lending aggregates; reconcile issuer classification.

children.label: Payments To Fund Longterm Loans To Related Parties
Payments For Proceeds From Other Interest Earning Assets

nodes.label: Cash flow from financing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported financing cash flow is the total. Customer deposits, equity, debt and distributions are presentation families, with overlapping total/component and net/gross disclosures.

children.label: Change in customer deposits
children.classification_note: Customer deposit liability funding is retained for the supplied industry universe; savings deposits are a subset of total deposits. Do not infer applicability to OneMain.

children.label: Stock issuance and repurchase cash flows
children.classification_note: Cash equity proceeds and repurchases are separated. Noncash stock issuance and acquisition equity consideration are supplementary, not cash funding.

children.label: Equity issuance cash proceeds
children.classification_note: Common stock issuance, preferred stock issuance and treasury stock sales may be included in broader cash equity funding amounts; reconcile share-class coverage.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of common stock
Proceeds from issuance of preferred stock and preference stock
Proceeds from sale of treasury stock
Employee share plan cash proceeds
children.classification_note: Stock option exercises produce cash proceeds and may be included in issuer-reported common share issuance proceeds.

children.label: Equity repurchase cash payments
children.classification_note: Common stock and other equity repurchases have different share-class scopes. Cash tax withholding on awards can overlap reported repurchase amounts.

children.label: Payments for repurchase of common stock
Payments For Repurchase Of Other Equity
Debt issuance and retirement cash flows
children.classification_note: Debt flows follow the long-term, short-term and other funding families. Net changes, gross issuance, repayments and lender-specific breakdowns overlap; no automatic aggregation is defined.

children.label: Long-term debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Long-term totals can include senior, subordinated and other debt classes. Instrument-class repayments can have different maturity coverage from issuance measures.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of subordinated long term debt
Proceeds from issuance of senior long term debt
Short-term debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Other short-term debt receipts and repayments exclude separately presented instrument classes such as commercial paper; establish residual coverage.

children.label: Proceeds from other short term debt
Repayments of other short term debt
Other and broad debt cash-flow alternatives
children.classification_note: All-debt proceeds and repayments can include other debt and notes payable. Instrument-specific and residual views are not incremental to the broad debt totals.

children.label: Repayments Of Debt And Capital Lease Obligations

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations
concepts.review_reason: Combines debt and lease obligations; reconcile against debt-only repayment and lease cash disclosures before selecting an aggregate.

children.label: Proceeds From Debt Net Of Issuance Costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Already net of third-party origination costs; separately mapped debt issuance payments must not be deducted again.

children.label: Secured and unsecured long-term debt
children.classification_note: Collateral views overlap seniority, instrument and maturity views elsewhere. These tags exclude tax-exempt secured or unsecured debt; do not sum across views.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Secured Debt
Proceeds From Issuance Of Unsecured Debt
Credit line drawdowns and repayments
children.classification_note: Long-term credit lines are a subset of all credit lines. Drawdowns are cash receipts, not unused borrowing capacity.

children.label: Proceeds From Long Term Lines Of Credit
Repayments Of Long Term Lines Of Credit
Commercial paper cash flows
children.classification_note: Commercial paper receipts and repayments may be included in other short-term debt totals.

children.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of Commercial Paper
Related party long-term debt
children.classification_note: Related-party long-term financing overlaps total debt receipts and repayments; loans made to affiliates belong to investing.

children.label: Receivable securitization borrowings
children.classification_note: These securitizations are collateralized borrowings, not sales of receivables. Avoid adding them to overlapping secured debt totals.

children.label: Payments of dividends
children.classification_note: Total cash dividends paid can include common and preferred payments below; do not add the total to its components. Stock dividends and dividend payable balances are supplementary.

children.label: Payments of dividends preferred stock and preference stock

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends
concepts.review_reason: Includes ordinary dividends to common, preferred and noncontrolling holders; its coverage can differ from the selected total dividends node.

children.label: Other financing cash flows
children.classification_note: Financing cost payments and debt issuance cost payments can overlap. Extinguishment costs exclude accrued interest; share withholding payments differ from noncash compensation expense.

children.label: Payments related to tax withholding for share based compensation

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Share-based-compensation withholding payments can relate to shares withheld or repurchased for employee taxes; establish overlap with reported equity repurchases.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs may already be netted against borrowings; separate cash issuance costs from noncash financing-cost amortization.

children.label: Proceeds from payments for other financing activities
Noncontrolling interest capital transactions
children.classification_note: Capital contributions and ownership reductions are distinct from dividends to noncontrolling interests.

nodes.label: Cash movement and balance reconciliation
nodes.classification_note: All cash-flow totals, period changes and instant endpoints must use compatible cash scope and dates. No beginning/ending duplicate concept mapping or unsupported FX/FCF calculation is created.

children.label: Reported changes in cash
children.classification_note: The supplied cash change already includes exchange-rate effects. The separately mapped exchange-rate effects explain the reconciliation and must not be added to the cash change again.

children.label: Change in cash and restricted cash, including FX

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIncludingExchangeRateEffect
concepts.review_reason: This net cash change already includes the exchange-rate effect; do not add a separately derived exchange-rate effect again.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash balance scopes
children.classification_note: Instant balances are reconciliation endpoints, not period cash flows. Cash excludes cash equivalents; restricted cash can be a subset of combined cash balances. Match beginning and ending scope.

children.label: Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: This cash reconciliation balance includes restricted cash; beginning and ending values require distinct instant contexts with a consistent scope.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash including disposal groups and discontinued operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsIncludingDisposalGroupAndDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: This broader cash balance includes disposal groups and discontinued operations; do not substitute it for a narrower reconciliation scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash and cash equivalents are components of broader cash reconciliation balances, not additional cash to add to those totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCash
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash alone excludes restricted cash equivalents and can already be included in the combined restricted-cash disclosure.

children.label: Cash And Cash Equivalents At Carrying Value
Exchange rate effect alternatives
children.classification_note: Continuing-operation cash scope differs from cash including disposal groups and discontinued operations; select the scope matching the cash reconciliation.

children.label: Exchange-rate effect on cash: continuing operations
Exchange-rate effect on cash: including discontinued operations

nodes.label: Supplementary cash-flow and noncash disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Supplementary facts are retained without treating accrual balances, noncash transactions, rates or overlapping payment disclosures as extra cash flows.

children.label: Supplementary cash payment disclosures
children.classification_note: Supplementary interest and tax disclosures may already be embedded in operating cash flow; do not add them as incremental payments.

children.label: Interest paid
children.classification_note: Net interest paid is a supplemental cash payment disclosure. Confirm amounts netted and avoid treating it as an additional deduction from operating cash flow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaidNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest paid differs from gross interest paid; identify the amounts netted before choosing between the two supplemental measures.

children.label: Income taxes paid and refunds
children.classification_note: All-jurisdiction gross and net tax payments differ from federal-only net payments. Refund receipts are already reflected in net tax payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet
concepts.review_reason: Net income taxes paid reflects refunds; do not add separately supplied refunds or gross payments without a reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross income tax payments differ from net-of-refund payments and jurisdiction-specific payment disclosures.

children.label: Income tax paid federal after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: Federal tax paid after refunds is a jurisdiction-specific net amount; distinguish it from federal gross payments and all-jurisdiction net tax.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds
concepts.review_reason: Tax refunds are receipts already reflected in net tax paid; use them only to reconcile gross and net cash tax measures.

children.label: Noncash lease additions and lease expense disclosures
children.classification_note: Operating ROU assets obtained in exchange for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements, not cash capital expenditures.

children.label: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements; exclude them from cash capital expenditures.

children.label: Acquisition consideration and purchase-price allocation
children.classification_note: Business purchase accounting and noncash consideration are separated from actual business acquisition and disposal cash flows.

children.label: Assets acquired and liabilities assumed
children.classification_note: Investments acquired in noncash or part-noncash acquisitions are retained as acquisition disclosures; they are not cash investment purchases.

children.label: Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — investments acquired
Other noncash and accrued cost disclosures
children.classification_note: Disclosed costs, tax carryforwards and noncash consideration do not establish cash receipts, cash payments or reconciliation adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationAllocationOfRecognizedPeriodCostsCapitalizedAmount
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized share-based payment cost is not automatically an expense add-back in operating cash flow.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TaxCreditCarryforwardAmount
concepts.review_reason: An instant tax-credit carryforward balance is not a cash tax receipt or deferred tax expense adjustment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestCostsCapitalized
concepts.review_reason: Capitalized interest is a cost measure and does not by itself identify cash interest paid or its activity classification.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueOfConsiderationGiven1
concepts.review_reason: Noncash consideration given must be separated from cash acquisition payments and identified by transaction.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax
concepts.review_reason: Excise tax incurred on repurchases does not establish the amount or timing of cash tax payments.

children.label: Restricted cash and investment balances
children.classification_note: This long-term combined balance includes investments and cannot automatically be included in the cash-flow cash reconciliation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Includes restricted long-term investments; identify the cash portion before reconciling cash and restricted cash.

children.label: Receivable sale and collection classification candidates
children.classification_note: Generic receivable receipts do not establish held-for-sale, trade receivable or investment classification. Assign to a primary activity only after issuer review.

children.label: Proceeds From Sale And Collection Of Other Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfOtherReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Other receivable sale and collection proceeds require issuer evidence to distinguish operating receipts from investment collections.

children.label: Proceeds From Sale And Collection Of Receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Combined receivable sales and collections do not specify trade, held-for-sale or investment scope; establish the appropriate activity.

children.label: Capitalized lease and loan cost cash payments
children.classification_note: Payments that create or prepare another asset require issuer-specific activity classification; do not automatically add to operating lease payments or debt issuance costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePaymentsUse
concepts.review_reason: Payments bring another asset to its intended condition and location; establish capitalization and cash-flow activity rather than treating them as ordinary lease payments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfLoanCosts
concepts.review_reason: Loan origination associated costs, usually collected through escrow, are not necessarily the issuer’s debt issuance costs; identify the underlying lending transaction.

children.label: FV-NI equity security movement candidates
children.classification_note: A balance movement in FV-NI investments can include valuation and other noncash effects; it is not automatically an investment purchase or sale.

children.label: Increase Decrease In Equity Securities FV-NI

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInEquitySecuritiesFvNi
concepts.review_reason: FV-NI investment changes may include valuation effects; establish the cash and noncash components before assigning an activity.
